A concept is one content type: a directory of markdown files sharing a fieldset.
Snippet: a posts concept with title, date, description, and a taxonomy tags field.
dir names the directory, label names the concept in the nav, and singular defaults to label when omitted.
routing is one of three shorthands with page as the default.
An embedded concept is never routable and reachable through reference or include, as fragments are.
The field vocabulary is the fifteen builders including the object and array containers.
fields is a fieldset of fields descriptors.
taxonomy true on a multiselect marks the tag field, at most one per concept.
defineConcept validates at declaration, so a bad permalink, datePrefix, or routing throws at module load.
